# OpenRide

> OpenRide (openride.bike) sells self-guided bike tours. Each tour is a page with day-by-day plans, lodging, food stops, and getting-there and getting-home options.

The first route is the Natchez Trace Parkway in Mississippi and Tennessee, a 444-mile National Park Service road with no commercial traffic. The lower Trace tour, Natchez Trace Inn-to-Inn: Jackson to Natchez, is 6 days and 5 nights through Jackson, Vicksburg, Canemount at Lorman and Natchez, an estimated 150 to 190 miles.

## Pages

- [Natchez Trace Inn-to-Inn: Jackson to Natchez](https://openride.bike/tours/natchez-lower/): the tour page, with a free sample day, FAQ, and paid access to every day and every inn.
- [Lower Natchez Trace](https://openride.bike/natchez-trace-lower.html): route overview, history, stops and FAQ.
- [Natchez Trace Parkway overview](https://openride.bike/natchez-trace.html): the full 444 miles in three segments, with an FAQ on segments and beginners.
- [OpenRide home](https://openride.bike/): all routes.
